what: PepsiCo makes snacks and drinks: Frito-Lay (Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos), Quaker, Pepsi, Gatorade, Mountain Dew and many more.
customers: Supermarkets, convenience stores, restaurants and vending, serving consumers in more than 200 countries.
moat: Dominant snack brands, a direct-store-delivery network and shelf space with retailers.
risks: Weight-loss drugs and health trends reducing snack demand
opportunities: A dividend yield above 4% with a very long record of increases
Its snacks business earns far higher margins than drinks and is the larger profit contributor
International markets grow faster than North America
watch: Frito-Lay North America volume trends and organic revenue growth.
